manufacturer.name: Tousek
manufacturer.note: Austrian gate automation manufacturer, and the most consistently manufacturer-hosted brand in this library so far - every document below is on a Tousek domain. It runs two document hosts: tousek.com/download, language-foldered with EN_<section>_<models> names, and download.tousek.at, which files the same documents by part number under montage and part branches. Both are registered as harvest targets. Note download.tousek.at was surfaced over plain HTTP; the URLs are recorded as they appeared rather than silently upgraded, and the link checker will report what the host actually does.
